name: Poison Gusherz Deli
description: Lineage: Durban Poison x Gushers Type: Sativa-dominant Hybrid Terpenes: Caryophyllene, Limonene, and Myrcene Aroma: Fruity sweetness with an edge of earthy spice Effects: Balanced high that can be relaxing yet uplifting Poison Gushers is a bold, flavor-packed cultivar that delivers a rush of fruity sweetness with an edge of earthy spice. Crafted for true cannabis enthusiasts, this strain combines vibrant, resinous buds with a balanced profile that’s both uplifting and deeply relaxing. Expect a burst of juicy, candy-like aroma on the nose, followed by a smooth, lingering finish. Perfect for unwinding after a long day or sparking creativity, Poison Gushers stands out as a precision-grown Michigan favorite—always fresh, always potent, always memorable.
